overview_description.description: InterSwap Labs enables secure and seamless swaps of native assets across multiple blockchain networks with a single transaction, eliminating the need for intermediary chains or bridges. It offers bridgeless liquidity unification and transportation across EVM, Cosmos, Solana, and Bitcoin. Built on the Axelar network, InterSwap Labs is the first fully composable native asset cross-chain Automated Market Maker (AMM) with unified liquidity.

product.description: A feature enabling swift cross-chain order fulfillment within seconds using Axelar-powered intents.

product.description: An advanced liquidity incentive model that rewards liquidity providers across chains.

product.name: Cross Chain Pools
product.description: Smart contracts enabling bridgeless native asset movement across ecosystems with permissionless pools and MEV protection.

product.description: A service allowing dApps to integrate multi-chain token support and expand single-chain AMMs to cross-chain AMMs.
